cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The alley's blocked. Excellent: our secret proposal picnic just got harder to discover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm carrying your table. We have to use the main road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Better camouflage. Everyone will assume we're moving house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now she can carry the chairs without suspecting romance. The disguise gets more convincing.

mechanism: A directs the helpers while celebrating every threatened exposure as a better disguise for the proposal.
confusable: Unlike claiming failure was always planned, A welcomes the new complication as improving concealment now.
comparison: A girlfriend arriving becomes an unwitting helper, unlike a failed supper club becoming a selective business dinner.
seedUse: The seed already assigns B table carrying and then proposes the girlfriend carry chairs, giving S01 control over the improving scheme.
